subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Which model-facing API should OpenClaw expose for ordinary append writes: this PR's optional `append?: boolean`, an explicit `mode` field, or a separate append tool?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and backward-compatible, but this is a persistent model/tool contract that affects prompts, exported types, recovery behavior, and future compatibility.

options.title: Accept `append?: boolean`
options.body: Land this PR's small additive contract after exact-head validation if maintainers want the narrowest backward-compatible extension.

options.title: Switch to explicit `mode`
options.body: Ask for a pre-merge API change if maintainers want room for additional write modes without another boolean contract.

options.title: Use a separate append tool
options.body: Pause or redirect the PR if maintainers want append behavior isolated from the destructive overwrite tool.

recommendation.title: Accept `append?: boolean`
recommendation.body: Land this PR's small additive contract after exact-head validation if maintainers want the narrowest backward-compatible extension.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the agent-runtime model-facing tool API, and recent history points to agent runtime ownership.
